Name: PairIdentityMismatch
Message: The peer discovered on the pair link belongs to a different redundant pair

Name: CrossloadCandidateRejected
Message: The peer refused the crossloaded candidate: staging validation failed on the peer

Name: CrossloadSnapshotRejected
Message: The peer refused the replicated state snapshot: layout incompatible or payload corrupt

Name: CrossloadInterrupted
Message: The crossload transfer was interrupted or carried garbled frames; the unit stays deSYNC

Name: CrossloadGenerationMismatch
Message: The peer's candidate generation does not match the staged generation on this unit; the pair does not hold one application generation

Name: OwnerConflict
Message: A claim was rejected: a live owner still holds the module's exclusive ownership

Name: OwnershipBarrierFailed
Message: The ownership barrier failed: an acquisition or verification failure released everything acquired; redundancy is lost

Name: SwapRefused
Message: The commanded role swap was refused: the pair is not in SYNC_READY

Name: DegradedChannel
Message: Ping/pong is lost on both channels but the peer demonstrably owns I/O: degraded-channel alarm; never claim
